verdict.rationale: New Relic's CLI supports recording deployment markers (change tracking) that appear alongside APM data, and NRQL/dashboards/alerts can be used to correlate metrics around deploy times, but the evidence pack lacks documentation of a dedicated change-tracking UI feature, automatic regression detection tied to deploys, or config-change tracking beyond deployment markers. missing for 10: dedicated change-tracking/regression-correlation UI docs, evidence of automatic config-change tracking, independent confirmation of deploy correlation workflow.
